question: Question linked to image # 1 Which of the following statements is FALSE with respect to the anatomical structure indicated by the blue arrow in the image?

options.opa: It is innervated by the median nerve.
options.opb: Its function is supination of the forearm.
options.opc: Participates in the stability of the distal radioulnar joint.
options.opd: It has its origin in the distal quarter of the anterior aspect of the ulna and its insertion in the distal quarter of the anterior face of the radius.

analysis: The anatomical structure indicated by the blue arrow in the image is the pronator quadratus muscle. It is not innervated by the median nerve, but rather by the anterior interosseous nerve, a branch of the median nerve. The pronator quadratus muscle functions to pronate the forearm, not supinate it. It plays a crucial role in stabilizing the distal radioulnar joint. The origin of the pronator quadratus muscle is the distal quarter of the anterior aspect of the ulna, and its insertion is the distal quarter of the anterior face of the radius.
